author: Olga Ernst
attribution: Photo: Olga Ernst, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Namib_High_School_signage,_Swakopmund_(2014).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted name plate in an uncial-style font on a yellow wall, Swakopmund. The blue relief plaque at left ('Erbaut im Jahre 1913', blackletter) is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Olga Ernst
attribution: Photo: Olga Ernst, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Wilhelmstal_Padstal_in_Namibia.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Roadside farm-stall board at Wilhelmstal (B2). 'PAD' and 'STAL' are split either side of an oryx-head logo. Keep the diaeresis in 'DROËWORS'. The blue bottom strip ('TOLL FREE 924', 'E-MED RESCUE 24 CHOOSE LIFE') is an advert distractor; vehicles behind the fence are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Pemba.mpimaji
attribution: Photo: Pemba.mpimaji, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gauss_Street_Sign_Namibia.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Two brown tourist direction signs (guest farms) with house, hiking and cave pictograms and right-turn arrows, on the B1 north of Otavi. 'CAVES' is a tiny label over the cave icon. Alternative query: 'Ghaub'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Olga Ernst
attribution: Photo: Olga Ernst, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Street_sign_in_Bismarck-Str._Swakopmund,_Namibia_(2014).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Old German enamel street plate with rusted edges, Swakopmund. The map may list the street as 'Bismarck Street' or 'Bismarckstraße'; the sign itself reads 'Bismarck-Str.'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Street sign in Bismarck-Str. Swakopmund, Namibia (2014).jpg
source_categories: Roads and streets named after Otto von Bismarck

author: Olga Ernst
attribution: Photo: Olga Ernst, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Okasise_river_sign,_Namibia.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White river-name sign with a blue wavy-water pictogram beside the road east of Wilhelmstal; mid-distance (about 170 px wide). It marks the Okasise river crossing. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Wiki.cullin
attribution: Photo: Wiki.cullin, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Owela_Museum_-_National_Theatre_of_Namibia_-_Old_Windhoek_Prison_-_Direction_Sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large brown tourist direction sign in Windhoek, seen from below, with museum/theatre/monument pictograms; the top five destinations go left, the bottom three right. A woman seen from behind is incidental. Alternative query: 'Alte Feste'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Owela Museum - National Theatre of Namibia - Old Windhoek Prison - Direction Sign.jpg

author: Pgallert
attribution: Photo: Pgallert, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mokganedi_Tlhabanello_High.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted lettering on the gate wall, Drimiopsis. The second line is in a brush-script font where the two 'l's are lowercase loop letters among capitals ('TlHABANEllO' = Tlhabanello); they could be misread as 'I'. The school crest at left and the 'AIDS KILLS / TAKE CONTROL' ribbon mural on the right wall are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: ER Bauer
attribution: Photo: ER Bauer, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_Namibia_Wildlife_Resorts_(NWR).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: English/German office-hours plate of a Namibia Wildlife Resorts office. 'NWR' is a stylised script logo. Spellings are as printed: 'BUROSTUNDEN' without umlaut and 'SONNENUTERGANG' (missing n). The dashes between times are square dots on the sign. Glare across the right of the lower lines. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Wiki.cullin
attribution: Photo: Wiki.cullin, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_Post_for_Altstadt_Restaurant_-_Biergarten_-_Hendrik_Witbooi_-_Anton_Lubowski_-_Swakopmund,_Namibia.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Pylon sign seen from below, Swakopmund: script 'Altstadt Restaurant' over a round logo ('EST. 2018' tiny), with two street-name light boxes ('HENDRIK WITBOOI', 'ANTON LUBOWSKI') on the same pole. The phone number is cut off behind the street box ('PHONE - 064 4...'). Alternative queries: 'Hendrik Witbooi' or 'Anton Lubowski' (street). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Sign Post for Altstadt Restaurant - Biergarten - Hendrik Witbooi - Anton Lubowski - Swakopmund, Namibia.jpg

author: Zairon
attribution: Photo: Zairon, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Windhuk_Bahnhofstra%C3%9Fe.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White street blade seen from below, Windhoek; the edge of a perpendicular blade crosses the 'F' between 'BAHNHO' and 'STRASSE'. The street is usually mapped as 'Bahnhof Street'. The cross street blade (text edge-on, ending '...VENUE'?) is not legible.

author: Pgallert
attribution: Photo: Pgallert, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Asab_General_Dealer.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White fascia over a store veranda in Asab, southern Namibia. Product logos (JOKO, MILK) on the fascia, MTC 'mtc make the connection' wall panels, a 'TAKE AWAY' sign and small posters are distractors.

author: Ossewa
attribution: Photo: Ossewa, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Namib-Naukluft_National_Park_-_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Green park rules board at the roadside. Only the park name and heading are targets; the warning pictograms, '100' speed-limit roundel, captions ('STRICTLY NO OFF-ROAD DRIVING', 'ADHERE TO THE SPEED LIMIT', 'IT IS ILLEGAL TO REMOVE PLANTS / ANIMALS', 'KEEP OUR PARK CLEAN - BRING OUT WHAT YOU TAKE IN', 'PLEASE REPORT ANY VIOLATIONS TO (064) 205 726') and the tiny sponsor line are secondary.
